driven_by: engine plan -> shrink --offline -> stage -> boot --installer, on the Kubuntu/Fedora clone

observed.plan: add-linux, 30G incumbent, 87 GiB target region, instalments carrier 12G at the end of disk
observed.shrink: installed ext4 root 40G -> 30G, recovery metadata on the shared partition
observed.stage: carrier /dev/sda8 (12G NTFS) created, ISO copied, standalone GRUB at \EFI\usbless\grubx64.efi, firmware entry 000C
observed.boot: internal carrier started the Ubuntu live system; graphical installer opened at the language page
observed.autoinstall: NOT engaged: no seed request reached the lab server and the installer waited for input

diagnosis: The plan's lab-only boot parameters ended with a nocloud-net source URL without a trailing slash (ds=nocloud-net;s=http://10.0.2.2:8770/autoinstall/ubuntu). cloud-init appends 'user-data' to that value, so the seed could not be fetched and the installer fell back to interactive mode.
next: Rewrite linux_params with a trailing-slash seed URL (chain.py now does), remove the current carrier with the product's own `cleanup --installer-only`, re-stage and boot; the loader and carrier are rebuilt from the plan.
